question: Only theme changes; todos and tab stay the same. Does filterTodos run again?
options: No, React reuses the cached result

say: Only theme changes. Todos and tab stay the same. Does filter todos run again?
explanation: The dependencies didn't change, so useMemo returns the result it cached last time. It runs again only when todos or tab change.
explainSay: No. The dependencies are the same, so use memo hands back the cached result. It recalculates only when todos or tab change.
